repos_data.description: A Tinder-like Android library to create the swipe cards effect. You can swipe left or right to like or dislike the content.
Photo Browser / Viewer inspired by Facebook's and Tweetbot's with ARC support, swipe-to-dismiss, image progress and more

repo_meta_data.description: Swipe to "like" or "dislike" any view, just like Tinder.app. Build a flashcard app, a photo viewer, and more, in minutes, not hours!
